guarantees.bh: FDR <= 0.05 under independence or PRDS and valid p-values.
guarantees.split_confirmation_bh: BH FDR <= 0.05 under independence or PRDS and valid holdout p-values; promotions are frozen before holdout opening.
guarantees.e_bh: FDR <= 0.05 under arbitrary dependence for valid e-values and a fixed family; e = 0.5 * p**(-0.5), with E[e] <= 1 under a uniform null p-value.

result_paragraph: On 100 shared planted datasets and the same pre-specified test suite, raw: recall 1.000, pooled FDP 0.153, 708 discoveries; bonferroni: recall 1.000, pooled FDP 0.145, 702 discoveries; bh: recall 1.000, pooled FDP 0.150, 706 discoveries; split_confirmation_bh: recall 1.000, pooled FDP 0.144, 701 discoveries; e_bh: recall 1.000, pooled FDP 0.143, 700 discoveries.
